summary: A successful deref adds the target to the kept-alive set until the current synchronous execution completes.

semantics.same_sync_execution: subsequent deref cannot observe target collected solely between the calls
semantics.clear: host clears kept objects after synchronous sequence

tests.name: two derefs stable
tests.input: const x={}; const r=new WeakRef(x); const a=r.deref(); const b=r.deref(); console.log(a===b)

tests.name: constructor also keeps target
tests.input: const x={}; const r=new WeakRef(x); console.log(r.deref()===x)
